behavior.name: Capture and Calibrate Hand-Eye
behavior.author: Gabriel Novas
behavior.description:
FULL Hand-Eye Calibration Behavior. One calibration per camera, robot and cell (the place where that robot and that camera stand): give the cell in the parameter "cell".
PHASE 1: AUTO-LAUNCH: MoveIt + RViz open automatically PHASE 2: YOU CONTROL: Move robot with MoveIt interface CAPTURE: Press SPACE at each pose PHASE 3: AUTO-DETECT: charuco_hand_eye detects Charuco in the pictures PHASE 4: AUTO-CALIBRATE: VISP calculates final calibration
Everything is stored in ~/calibrations/CAMERA/extrinsic_calibration/ROBOT/CELL/: - pictures/ and robot_poses/ (what was captured) - charuco_table_poses/ (detections) - calibration_results/camera_extrinsics.yaml (the result: robot, cell, frames and transform) - calibration_results/camera_extrinsics.ini and extrinsic_matrix.yaml (other formats)

param.name: total_poses
param.label: Total Poses
param.hint: Number of poses to capture (minimum 5, maximum 50)

param.name: robot_name
param.label: Robot Name
param.hint: Select robot model (ur5e or ufactory_lite6): it sets the MoveIt launch, the frames and the calibration folder.

param.name: cell
param.label: Cell
param.hint: Cell the robot and the camera stand in (for example right, left, basic, kth_table). The calibration is stored per cell.

param.name: robot_ip
param.label: Robot IP
param.hint: Leave empty: the address of the cell is taken from the robot addresses file of the installation (UR_ONROBOT_ROBOT_ADDRESSES). Type one only to use another robot.

param.name: camera_intrinsics_file
param.label: Intrinsic Calibration Profile
param.hint: Select intrinsic camera profile from dropdown menu

param.name: eye_in_hand
param.label: Eye-in-Hand
param.hint: True if camera on robot, False if fixed

param.name: use_fake_hardware
param.label: Use Fake Hardware
param.hint: True for simulation, False for real robot

param.name: calibration_file_name
param.label: Calibration File
param.hint: Base name for calibration files (without extension)
